title: Publish StagedProposalProcessor v1.3
summary: Publishes build 3 of the StagedProposalProcessor (release 1) on the SPP repo. This version addresses a security issue: existing deployments are strongly recommended to update.
description:
Calls `createVersion` on the SPP plugin repo to publish v1.3 (release 1, build 3).

Sub-proposal creation now reverts the outer tx when any automatic sub-body's `createProposal` fails. This version also hardens the stage tally against same-transaction flows where a trusted sub-body could reenter.

All existing deployments are strongly recommended to update to build 3. Installation parameters are unchanged versus build 2.
